submittedPrompt: 制作真实rich-editor代码块局部组件，意图宽900px，不加弹窗标题或关闭X。只画局部组件，不画父页/owner导航/浏览器壳。平面白/浅灰、#272b3a文字、#657084次级、#e6e9f1细线、#4566c6蓝色、小圆角、清晰紧凑中文；长表单可延长纵向且主要动作可达。无纹理渐变或协议字段输入。source-derived与角色/parent仅metadata。准确header左侧代码语言文本输入值“javascript”（支持datalist但未展开，不画新语言选择弹窗），右侧4个按钮“行号”“折行”“折叠”“复制代码”；行号和折行处于pressed，折叠未选中。当前为virtual/lazy预览，非激活CodeMirror：主体pre/code显示完整两行“const value = 1;”“console.log(value);”，克制语法色，无编辑光标/工具条/行号gutter（虚拟pre尚未挂载CM）。不要已复制状态、只读复制fallback textarea或折叠代码分支，不额外加复制全文/运行/下载/保存按钮。

sourceContracts.title: Rich editor code-block controls and copy fallback
permissionRules: Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.

fields.constraints: Local code block text; editor read-only guards inherited.

actions.guard: Owner session; control-specific guards described in permissionRules.

responsive.behavior: At <=720px notebook sidebar is a fixed drawer min(290px,85vw), main fills viewport and bottom navigation is used; desktop has rail + resizable sidebar + main. See apps/web/style.css:1032 and apps/web/workbench.css:437.
